necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal events. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
